text:
li: quick ping — onboarding atlas64k-int4q-v1: when autoscaler prunes a KV shard (burst down) i see duplicated tokens emitted right after token ~16384. only on int4 tiled kernels + rope per-layer rescale. fp16/int8 clean. logs + mini repro below. :confused:

nina: can you paste the exact command and whether this is on dedicated or staging?

li: staging box, 1xA100, tiled int4 runtime. repro: 
```\n# repro\npython infra/run_infer.py --model atlas64k-int4q-v1 --quant int4-tiled --rope-rescale per-layer \\\n  --context 65536 --prefill examples/long_notice.prefill --simulate-scale prune_after=40s \\\n  --dump-kv /tmp/atlas_kv.json\n```

li: log excerpt:
```\n[2026-01-09T09:12:03Z] prefill done pos=16290\n[2026-01-09T09:12:05Z] autoscale: pruning shard 3 (active->standby)\n[2026-01-09T09:12:05Z] generate start at pos=16295\n[2026-01-09T09:12:05Z] output[16300]=\"the\"\n[2026-01-09T09:12:05Z] output[16301]=\"the\"  <-- duplicate token\n[2026-01-09T09:12:05Z] kv_ptr mismatch: expected=0x2a1ff got=0x2a1fe (pos=16300)\n```

chris: duplication + kv_ptr off-by-one during shard prune suggests stale pointer arithmetic when we compact tiled int4 pages. did you diff the kv indices before/after prune?

li: yes, dump shows the same KV key present twice after compaction, with adjacent offsets pointing to the same physical entry. snippet: 
```\n// kv dump (pos -> page:offset)\n16298 -> 3:1022\n16299 -> 3:1023\n16300 -> 0:0000  <- after prune page 3 remapped to page 0\n16301 -> 0:0000  <- duplicate mapping\n```

nina: interesting. tiled int4 uses 10-bit offsets inside a 1024-entry page. if we remap pages during prune and apply RoPE per-layer rescale that recomputes indices, there might be an overflow when we cast page*page_size + offset into uint16 for the tiled kernels. can you try setting TILED_OFFSET_TYPE=uint32 at runtime?

li: quick test with TILED_OFFSET_TYPE=uint32 fixed the duplicates. so it's likely a storage/integer-width bug in the compaction path.

opsbot: created INC-2026-999: "atlas64k int4 tiled KV compaction overflow causing duplicate tokens on prune". Linked to this thread and tagged eng-ml oncall.

qa-bot: suggested test added: long-context autoscale-prune smoke (contexts: 32k, 48k, 64k) across quant profiles; compare token sequences and KV-page maps pre/post prune.

chris: action items:
- li: open runtime PR to widen tiled offsets to 32-bit and add unit test for prune remap.
- nina: add autoscale-prune scenario to onboarding smoke and nightly regression (int4-tiled + rope per-layer).
- li: run token-diff bench (fp16 vs int4-tiled before/after fix) and post artifact (token diffs + kv maps).

li: note on perf: switching offsets to 32-bit increases KV metadata memory ~+0.6% for atlas64k config, negligible compared to correctness win. i'll include perf numbers in PR.

nina: also add a compatibility note in model onboarding docs: "avoid tiled int4 compaction with live prune until offset-width validated".

li: will do PR and link once ready. thanks all. :rocket:
